name: Whisper Cord
description: Lay a cord of soul force through empty air and listen for the whisper of any soul that brushes it.

name: Loose Weft
description: Spread a loose weft of soul force so a target walking into it loses its footing of thought for a breath.

name: Flicker Snag
description: Snag a gathering technique on a flicker of soul force so it stumbles before release.

name: Cord Turning
description: Flick a laid cord across the path of a soul strike and turn it away from the self.

name: Drawn Noose
description: Draw a noose of soul force closed on a target's resolve and hold it until the target stops straining.

name: Snapped Cord
description: Snap a taut cord of soul force into the soul it was laid for so the blow lands past the body's guard.

name: Spring Sense
description: Feel the tension of a coiled soul spring to learn how near a foe stands to it.

name: Bent Prong
description: Bend a prong of soul force across a target's path so it must stop or tear itself loose.

name: Spring Guard
description: Coil a spring of soul force at the brow that gives under a push and sends it back.

name: Dull Jolt
description: Release a coiled spring of soul force in one dull jolt against the soul that tripped it.

name: Tension Step
description: Load a spring of soul force underfoot and let it throw the body a stride forward.

name: Wound Spring
description: Wind a spring of soul force tight and loose it so every soul in a ring about the trigger feels the blow.

name: Held Tension
description: Keep a spring of soul force wound against a target's will so it cannot rise to full strength.

name: Loop Reading
description: Read the slight give in a laid loop to learn what kind of soul has touched it.

name: Light Bight
description: Throw a light bight of soul force over a limb to slow it for a breath.

name: Wide Loop
description: Open a wide loop of soul force round a target's senses so the edges of the world blur briefly.

name: Hoop Guard
description: Wear a ring of soul force close about the self that catches mental pushes before they land.

name: Hairline Barb
description: Send a hairline barb of soul force through a loop and into the soul beyond a guard.

name: Pivot Hitch
description: Loop a soul line round a fixed mark and pivot the body about it.

name: Closing Ring
description: Tighten a ring of soul force round a target's limbs by degrees until it can barely move.

name: Turned Loop
description: Turn a loop of soul force against an incoming soul strike and throw part of it back at the sender.

name: Net Reading
description: Cast a fine net of soul force outward and read which strands go slack as souls move through.

name: Cast Mesh
description: Fling a small mesh of soul force over a target to tangle its first movement.

name: Net Guard
description: Spread a net of soul force close round the self so thin soul probes snag in it.

name: Fray Edge
description: Fray the edge of a target's gathered force with one pass of the soul net.

name: Snagging Pulse
description: Pulse soul force through a net so the soul caught in it takes a sharp jolt.

name: Drifting Step
description: Ride the slack of a thrown net to drift the body a stride away from a strike.

name: Wide Weave
description: Weave a wide net of soul force over a group so their sense of position drifts for several breaths.

name: Gathering Net
description: Draw the net slowly together so every soul inside it feels its force pressed down.

name: Piercing Skein
description: Run a skein of soul force through the net and into the soul behind a guard.

name: Catch Sense
description: Feel the click of a soul catch as it is tripped and learn the direction of the one who tripped it.

name: Hair Trigger
description: Leave a trigger fine as a hair that breaks a technique the moment its user draws force.

name: Rapid Clasp
description: Clasp a limb with a catch of soul force that closes the moment it is touched.

name: Catch Shield
description: Set a catch of soul force that snaps up as a barrier when a soul strike draws near.

name: Slight Spring
description: Let a slight spring of soul force fire the instant a catch gives way.

name: Double Catch
description: Set two catches of soul force in a row so a target freed from the first is held by the second.

name: Rebound Catch
description: Spring a catch of soul force that throws a probing soul back along the line it came.
